title: Drunk Cowboy Makes A Fool Of Himself At The Airport
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On August 28th, 2023. Officers were called to the airport in reference to a highly intoxicated man who had been harassing the gate agents after they denied him boarding due to how drunk he was. When officers tried to get him to calm down, he didn’t listen and refused to go away. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
